stories.title: PM Modi attends ASEAN-India Summit in Manila
stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi is in Manila for the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit, where he stated the visit aims to strengthen a collective commitment to a peaceful, prosperous and resilient Indo-Pacific. India and ASEAN also agreed to deepen cooperation on disaster management, including enhanced early warning systems.

stories.title: Congress questions Census 2027 religious categories
stories.summary: The Congress party has labeled the Census 2027 process a farce after a portal listed 287 religions, including various specific sects and groups. The list was removed without explanation after the Home Ministry received a query. The party says the initial categorization defies any understanding.

stories.title: BJP criticizes Sonia Gandhi memoir launch
stories.summary: The BJP has described the launch of Sonia Gandhi's memoir as a damaging self-goal, alleging the book attempts to sanitize the party's past. A spokesperson claimed the memoir ignores the 1984 anti-Sikh massacre and the Emergency. The party maintains the launch exposes the Congress's past misdeeds.

stories.title: Calcutta High Court initiates contempt proceedings against Abhishek Banerjee
stories.summary: The Calcutta High Court has initiated criminal contempt proceedings against Trinamool Congress leader Abhishek Banerjee. Justice Krishna Rao stated that remarks made in a speech and a social media post scandalized the court and interfered with the administration of justice. Banerjee has 15 days to respond.

stories.title: Bilkis Bano challenges bail order for two convicts
stories.summary: Bilkis Bano has expressed shock at the Supreme Court's decision to grant bail to two men convicted of crimes during the 2002 Gujarat riots. Bano stated she was neither informed nor heard before the order was passed. She learned of the decision through press reports.

stories.title: Delhi High Court sets deadline for AAP leaders in contempt case
stories.summary: The Delhi High Court has granted Arvind Kejriwal and other AAP leaders a final three weeks to file replies in a suo motu criminal contempt case. The proceedings were initiated following remarks made against Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma. The court noted that response rights will close thereafter.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi questions ECI on electoral revision process
stories.summary: Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi has told the Supreme Court that the Election Commission failed to provide proof that the special intensive revision of electoral rolls was a unanimous decision. Gandhi submitted that no minutes, file notings or recorded approvals were produced in the commission's affidavit.

stories.title: INDIA bloc leaders seek to question Election Commission
stories.summary: Thirteen INDIA bloc leaders have moved the Supreme Court for permission to pose 48 questions to the Election Commission. The petitioners seek records regarding decision-making, disagreements among commissioners and technology used during the special intensive revision of electoral rolls. The court has been asked to intervene.

stories.title: INDIA bloc leaders attend Sonia Gandhi memoir launch
stories.summary: The official launch of Sonia Gandhi's memoir, Belonging, served as a gathering for INDIA bloc leaders on Monday. Six state chief ministers and representatives from five allied parties attended the event at the ITC Maurya hotel. The gathering was described as a show of solidarity.

stories.title: Opposition requests Supreme Court to query Election Commission
stories.summary: Opposition leaders have asked the Supreme Court for permission to question the Election Commission regarding the special intensive revision of electoral rolls. A submitted list of 48 questions seeks details on who ordered the nationwide revision and how specific decisions were reached during the process.

stories.title: Delhi High Court addresses contempt case against AAP leaders
stories.summary: Criminal contempt proceedings against Arvind Kejriwal and other AAP leaders continue in the Delhi High Court. The case was triggered by remarks made by the politicians against a high court judge. The court has previously issued notices to the leaders involved in the matter.

stories.title: Congress forms panel for UP seat-sharing talks
stories.summary: The Congress party has established a five-member committee to manage seat-sharing negotiations ahead of upcoming elections in Uttar Pradesh. The party has also announced plans to commence its formal election campaign during the first week of December.

stories.title: Eight killed in Uttarakhand bus accident
stories.summary: Eight people were killed and 26 injured when a passenger bus plunged into a 100-metre-deep gorge in Tehri Garhwal on Monday. The bus reportedly lost control near Gular bridge while traveling from Haridwar. Rescue operations were conducted by police and the State Disaster Response Force.

stories.title: Five arrested for Grindr-based robbery scheme
stories.summary: Police in Malkajgiri have arrested five individuals accused of using the Grindr dating app to lure and rob men. The group allegedly spiked victims' drinks with intoxicating substances. Authorities linked the suspects to 14 cases across multiple regions. One additional suspect remains at large.

stories.title: Two killed in Delhi building collapse
stories.summary: A two-storey building collapse in Delhi’s Jwala Nagar on Tuesday resulted in the deaths of a 30-year-old man and a three-year-old girl. Four other tenants were injured in the incident. Police and rescue teams were dispatched to the site to clear the debris.

stories.title: Gas leak reported at ONGC well in Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: A gas leak occurred during drilling operations at an ONGC well in the Konaseema district on Tuesday. Residents within a one-kilometre radius were alerted and evacuated as a precaution. The company's crisis management team is working to cap the well. Officials stated there was no blowout.

stories.title: Head constable killed in Punjab
stories.summary: A 42-year-old head constable was found dead in Gurdaspur on Sunday, marking the sixth police fatality in the state this year. Authorities are investigating a social media claim of responsibility by an outfit called Tehreek-e-Taliban Hindustan. The Chief Minister has announced an ex-gratia payment for the family.

stories.title: Two dead following house collapse in Delhi
stories.summary: A building collapse in Delhi's Shahdara on Tuesday morning left two people dead, including a three-year-old child. Four other tenants were injured when the ground and first-floor structure fell. Local police and fire services initiated rescue operations immediately upon receiving reports of the incident.

stories.title: Road accidents in Uttarakhand leave 13 dead
stories.summary: Seventeen people died in five separate road accidents across Tehri and Rudraprayag districts between Monday night and Tuesday morning. In the most severe incident, a passenger bus plunged into a 100-metre-deep gorge, killing nine people. Authorities confirmed the toll as rescue operations concluded.

stories.title: Six killed in Rudraprayag vehicle accident
stories.summary: Six people died late Monday night when their vehicle veered off the Banswada-Mohankhal road and fell into a deep gorge. Police were alerted to the accident via a distress call at 10 pm. The vehicle was reportedly carrying up to ten passengers at the time.

stories.title: Shop owner and son arrested after boy killed
stories.summary: Police in Odisha arrested a shop owner and his son following the death of a 13-year-old boy accused of stealing a biscuit packet. The arrests occurred after villagers staged a 12-hour protest with the body, demanding action against those responsible for the incident.

stories.title: Mother and son killed in Barabanki road accident
stories.summary: A 65-year-old woman and her 40-year-old son died after a speeding dumper hit their motorcycle near Bhanmau crossing. The vehicle dragged the motorcycle for 300 metres before stopping. Police have sent the bodies for post-mortem examination as part of the ongoing inquest.

stories.title: Two killed in Delhi building collapse
stories.summary: A two-storey building collapsed in east Delhi's Vivek Vihar, resulting in two deaths. The victims included a child. Local authorities are managing the site of the incident.

stories.title: Six dead after bus falls into gorge
stories.summary: A bus accident in Uttarakhand resulted in six deaths after the vehicle plunged 300 feet into a gorge. Emergency responders successfully recovered 20 injured passengers from the site. Authorities are currently managing the aftermath of the crash.

stories.title: Telangana suspends 23 pharmacy-linked medical shops
stories.summary: The Drugs Wing of TG SAFE suspended the licences of 23 medical shops linked to online delivery platforms including Zepto, Tata 1mg, and Apollo 24/7. The action follows an enforcement drive to verify compliance with statutory provisions governing the sale and distribution of medicines.

stories.title: RBI reports microfinance sector recovery
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India reports that microfinance sector stability has returned after two years of contraction. Industry-wide early-stage delinquency fell to 1.9 percent in June 2026 from 6.1 percent a year earlier. The regulator maintains that responsible lending must precede loan sanctions.

stories.title: Meta adjusts Instagram recommendations in India
stories.summary: Meta has updated Instagram's recommendation systems in India to limit the visibility of sexually suggestive and violent content. The change follows a request from the Centre for the company to tighten checks on material that could disturb public order or lead to violence.

stories.title: Chennai publisher arrested over fake library books
stories.summary: The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption arrested R Mohan, publisher of Akhal Vilakku Publications, for allegedly procuring fake books for government libraries. The investigation began after writer Perumal Murugan alleged that books by unknown authors were being displayed at the Periyar Arivulagam library.

stories.title: MCD to outsource stadium management
stories.summary: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi plans to partner with private operators to develop and manage 13 stadiums. The initiative aims to upgrade infrastructure and provide free coaching to local schoolchildren. The commissioner intends to transform the facilities into professionally managed multi-sport centres.

stories.title: FSSAI challenges Red Bull energy drink label
stories.summary: The FSSAI issued a notice to Red Bull regarding its energy drink label, citing concerns over high sugar content. The regulator gave the company seven days to explain why the label should not be prohibited for its potential to mislead consumers regarding added sugar intake.

stories.title: VITMEE 2027 registration opens
stories.summary: Registration for the VIT Masters Entrance Examination 2027 is now open. The examination is scheduled for May 2, 2027, and will be conducted in a computer-based test format over a two-hour duration.

stories.title: JEE Main 2027 registration deadline approaches
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency has issued a reminder for engineering aspirants to complete their registration for the JEE Main 2027. The application window is currently closing.

stories.title: Kunal Bahl reflects on visa rejection
stories.summary: Kunal Bahl, who grew up in New Delhi, discussed how a rejected H-1B visa influenced his career path. Bahl moved to the United States to study at the University of Pennsylvania before eventually choosing to work for himself.

stories.title: Delhi minister denies Yamuna froth
stories.summary: Delhi Water Minister Parvesh Sahib Singh claimed there is no froth on the 52-km stretch of the Yamuna flowing through the capital. He rejected allegations that devotees were forced to celebrate Chhath Puja near polluted water, attributing the criticism to political opposition.

stories.title: Minister faces criticism for tiger pursuit
stories.summary: Conservationists are demanding action against Tamil Nadu Minister Vanni Arasu after video footage showed him pursuing a tiger in the Mudumalai Tiger Reserve. The Minister was filmed on a forest department safari vehicle. Critics have urged officials to register a case under the Wildlife Protection Act.

stories.title: Karnataka to relocate 56 elephants
stories.summary: Minister K.M. Shivalinge Gowda announced that the Karnataka government will relocate 56 elephants from Belur taluk to the Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary within one month. The decision follows protests by local residents regarding the presence of the animals in the region.

stories.title: Cases against 275 traders for cheating on weights in Karnataka
stories.summary: Officials from the Department of Food, Civil Supplies, Consumer Affairs, and Legal Metrology inspected nine major Agricultural Produce Markets in Karnataka. They registered cases against 275 traders for manipulating weights and violating standards, issuing fines of ₹9.6 lakh. Farmers had reported that their produce weights were being falsified.

stories.title: Bird flu detected at two farms in Kerala’s Alappuzha
stories.summary: Authorities in Alappuzha have confirmed bird flu at two poultry farms. A culling operation for approximately 26,000 birds is scheduled to begin Wednesday to contain the infection. The cull will cover a one-kilometre radius around the affected farms in Ambalappuzha North, Ambalappuzha South and Chennithala panchayats.

stories.title: Search intensifies for elephant blamed for 16 deaths
stories.summary: Forest personnel are tracking a solitary male tusker known as Kabra Kaan, which officials link to 16 deaths in Surajpur and Balrampur over the last seven months. The forest department has approved radio-collaring the animal, though officials noted that tranquilising an elephant remains a difficult process.

stories.title: Supreme Court warns states of fines over Yamuna pollution
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has ordered that states, Union territories and districts will face fines if water quality in the Yamuna deteriorates within their jurisdictions. The court directed tougher monitoring of treatment plants and drains, seeking to enforce shared accountability for pollution across the entire river basin.

stories.title: Pollution in Yamuna increased despite huge expenditure
stories.summary: The Supreme Court observed that pollution levels in the Yamuna have risen despite significant spending on cleaning efforts. The court directed the Central Pollution Control Board to monitor water quality at state and district borders, noting that industrial pollutants and sewage must be addressed at the source.

stories.title: Electrocution identified as leading cause of elephant deaths
stories.summary: Data from the Union environment ministry shows 1,765 elephants died of unnatural causes over 17 years. Electrocution accounted for 1,185 of these deaths, more than five times the number attributed to poaching. Train collisions and poisoning were also cited as significant factors in the total casualty count.

stories.title: LPG tanker targeted in missile attack in Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Union minister Sarbananda Sonowal confirmed that all 24 Indian seafarers aboard the Panama-flagged TARA GAS are safe following a missile attack in the Strait of Hormuz. The government is monitoring the situation and remains in contact with the ship management company regarding the 25-member crew.

stories.title: Modi calls for peace and predictability at ASEAN summit
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the ASEAN-India Summit in the Philippines, stating that the region should be determined by cooperation rather than competition. He emphasised that the world requires peace and stability, suggesting that India and the ASEAN bloc possess the collective resolve to shape their future.

stories.title: Trump, Xi and Putin to meet in Shenzhen
stories.summary: Presidents Trump, Xi and Putin are scheduled to meet in Shenzhen on November 19. While the leaders intend to project power, analysts suggest a trilateral outcome is unlikely. Beijing is reportedly seeking recognition of its sphere of influence in Asia without offering concessions on denuclearisation.

stories.title: Jaishankar describes emerging world order as more complex
stories.summary: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar stated at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit that the global order is undergoing a transition. He suggested the new environment will be more transactional and marked by sharper competition, noting that the world will likely feature more variables and less cohesion.

stories.title: Modi lays foundation stone for Manila gurudwara
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Khalsa Diwan Gurudwara in Manila, the oldest in the Philippines, to participate in a foundation-stone laying ceremony for its redevelopment. Originally established in 1901, the site serves as a cultural link between India and the Philippines.

stories.title: Modi attends gala dinner in traditional Philippines attire
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended a gala dinner hosted by President Ferdinand R Marcos at the Philippine International Convention Centre. For the event, which was held for dignitaries attending the ASEAN summits, the Prime Minister wore a traditional Barong Tagalog and watched a performance of the Ramayana.

stories.title: Asia takes centre stage in global powerplay
stories.summary: US President Trump is meeting Indo-Pacific partners in Manila before travelling to China for talks with President Xi and an expected trilateral meeting with President Putin. Prime Minister Modi is also in the Philippines for the ASEAN-India and East Asia summits, coinciding with the high-stakes diplomatic gathering.

stories.title: Kremlin hint raises odds of Trump-Kim meeting
stories.summary: Analysts suggest a meeting between Donald Trump and Kim Jong Un at the APEC summit in Shenzhen is possible. A report from Russia's Interfax agency quoted the Kremlin saying Putin could meet the North Korean leader if he attends, which observers view as a signal of intent.

stories.title: Modi highlights Act East policy at ASEAN summit
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi told the ASEAN-India Summit that the world faces constant crises and requires stability. He noted that India's Act East policy has expanded bilateral cooperation into digital technologies, defence and space, with over 100 initiatives currently underway between India and the 11-member bloc.

stories.title: Opinion: Opinion | The World's Biggest Spy Story May Be Hiding Behind The Nvidia Scandal
US banks report outages following tech disruptions
stories.summary: Users have reported service issues at multiple US banks including Chase, Bank of America and Wells Fargo. Downdetector tracks these complaints, though the precise nature of the disruptions remains unconfirmed. The outages occurred days after nationwide flight disruptions and widespread issues with Microsoft services.

stories.title: Microsoft outage costs Indian IT industry $200 million
stories.summary: Market intelligence firm EIIRTrend estimates the recent Microsoft outage caused a $200 million loss for the Indian IT industry. The figure accounts for lost billable hours and project delays across global time-and-material contracts. The firm estimated an average loss of four billing hours per project.

stories.title: Karnataka aims to become global hub for AI, deep tech, semiconductors
stories.summary: Chief Minister D K Shivakumar says Karnataka is positioning itself as a global hub for artificial intelligence, deep technology, and semiconductor manufacturing. The state plans to lead the next phase of global innovation, backed by its research institutions, startup ecosystem, skilled workforce, and progressive policies.

stories.title: Indian Oil gets government nod for sustainable aviation fuel production
stories.summary: Indian Oil plans to produce enough sustainable aviation fuel at its Panipat facility to meet the country's 1 percent blending target for international flights by 2027. The refiner is currently seeking agreements with airlines before committing to further investments in the technology.

stories.title: Software bug causes Chase payment disruptions across US banks
stories.summary: A software bug within JPMorgan Chase internal hardware systems caused transaction delays and access issues for customers at several major U.S. banks on Monday. The company says it is working to bring services back online. The bug did not discriminate between banks.

stories.title: US tightens AI chip curbs on overseas data centers
stories.summary: The Commerce Department is restricting shipments of advanced chips to data centers in countries like Thailand and Malaysia to prevent Chinese firms from accessing computing power. The rule also imposes new requirements on overseas data centers that supply significant volumes of power to Chinese-headquartered companies.

stories.title: India calls for country-driven approach to global just transition
stories.summary: India has called for a country-driven approach to the Just Transition Work Programme at the COP31 climate conference. Union environment minister Bhupender Yadav stated that developing countries must be allowed to determine their own pathways based on national priorities and circumstances rather than a uniform global mandate.

stories.title: Prince William praises India for balancing growth and sustainability
stories.summary: Prince William praised India's efforts to balance economic growth with environmental protection during the Earthshot Prize 2026 Impact Assembly in Mumbai. The Prince of Wales highlighted the country's achievements in renewable energy, describing India as a picture of colour, complexity, and possibility.

stories.title: El Nino fuels rare triple-cyclone spell over Bay of Bengal
stories.summary: A strengthening El Nino is driving a third storm towards the Andhra Pradesh coast, following cyclones Arnab and Murasu. Weather officials expect the warming effect to reach its strongest level on record by December, keeping sea surface temperatures high enough to sustain the unusual cyclonic activity.

stories.title: Prince William and Kate Middleton visit Mumbai for Earthshot event
stories.summary: Prince William and Kate Middleton visited Mumbai to meet finalists of The Earthshot Prize 2026. The couple toured the Bandra Reclamation Garden, where the Prince drove an electric three-wheeler with the Princess of Wales as a passenger. The event showcased innovations aimed at solving environmental problems.

stories.title: WHO adds Oxford-SII vaccine to Ebola clinical trials
stories.summary: The World Health Organisation has recommended adding a candidate vaccine developed by Oxford University and the Serum Institute of India to ongoing clinical trials. The vaccine specifically targets the Bundibugyo virus, which is responsible for the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

stories.title: NMC mandates cashless treatment scheme for road accident victims
stories.summary: The National Medical Commission has directed all government medical colleges and hospitals to onboard the PM-RAHAT scheme. The initiative aims to provide cashless treatment to road accident victims during the critical golden hour. Institutions have been asked to prioritize the implementation of the program.

stories.title: Health Minister confirms H5N1 negative results for 23 persons
stories.summary: Health Minister K.G. Arunraj reported that 23 persons, including poultry workers and veterinary staff, have tested negative for H5N1 avian influenza. The individuals were monitored following their association with affected poultry farms in Cuddalore. Testing continues for the remaining identified contacts.

stories.title: Dengue cases spike in Thiruvananthapuram
stories.summary: Thiruvananthapuram has reported 97 confirmed dengue cases and 200 probable cases over the last 10 days. The Karyavattom campus of Kerala University and the Cliff House compound have emerged as hotspots. Health officials suspect the actual transmission rate is higher than current figures suggest.

stories.title: National Health Accounts show high out-of-pocket spending in Kerala
stories.summary: National Health Accounts data for 2023-24 shows Kerala households pay nearly two-thirds of the state's total health expenditure from their own pockets. The state's annual per capita out-of-pocket spending reached 8,870 rupees, significantly higher than the national average of 2,901 rupees.

stories.title: Patient protests alleged medical negligence at government hospital
stories.summary: A patient whose leg was amputated three months ago has launched an indefinite protest demanding an impartial investigation into his treatment. While a preliminary report by the medical superintendent denied negligence, the patient is seeking access to his complete medical records to support his claims.

stories.title: Severe cyclonic storm Murasu approaches Andhra Pradesh coast
stories.summary: Cyclone Murasu has intensified into a severe cyclonic storm with wind speeds expected to reach 120 kmph. Authorities have closed schools and colleges in Chennai and Tiruvallur districts as the system moves toward the south Andhra Pradesh coast. The storm follows the recent arrival of Cyclone Arnab.

stories.title: Cyclone Akvan intensifies over Bay of Bengal
stories.summary: A weather system over the Bay of Bengal has intensified into a severe cyclonic storm named Akvan. The storm is moving north-northwest toward the Andhra Pradesh coast at 10 kmph. Officials are monitoring the trajectory as the system continues to gain strength.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh puts coastal districts on alert for Cyclone Akvan
stories.summary: Home Minister Vangalapudi Anitha has directed officials to remain on high alert as Cyclone Akvan approaches. District collectors and police superintendents have been ordered to coordinate disaster management efforts to prevent loss of life and property as the storm intensifies toward a very severe classification.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh braces for Cyclone Akvan landfall
stories.summary: Cyclonic storm Akvan is expected to intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm before crossing the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts on November 20. The India Meteorological Department reports the system is moving slowly, currently located about 610 km east of the coast.

stories.title: Cyclone Akvan to become severe storm
stories.summary: The India Meteorological Department reports Cyclone Akvan is moving slowly over the Bay of Bengal. It is expected to intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm by November 19, with landfall projected between Nellore and Tuni on the Andhra Pradesh coast around noon on November 20.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh and Odisha prepare for third cyclone
stories.summary: Andhra Pradesh and Odisha are bracing for their third cyclone in three weeks. The India Meteorological Department expects Cyclone Akvan to make landfall near Nellore and Tuni on November 20. Odisha has begun evacuations and cancelled leave for officials in eight districts to manage the incoming weather.

stories.title: Cyclone Akvan tracks toward Andhra-Yanam coast
stories.summary: Cyclone Akvan is the third storm to threaten the Andhra Pradesh coast in less than a month, following Arnab and Murasu. The India Meteorological Department expects the system to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm before reaching the Andhra-Yanam coast around noon on November 20.

stories.title: IMD tracks intensifying Cyclone Akvan
stories.summary: The India Meteorological Department reports that a deep depression has intensified into Cyclonic Storm Akvan. The system is expected to reach very severe status by November 19 before crossing the coast between Nellore and Tuni. The agency continues to monitor the storm as it moves toward landfall.

stories.title: Iran provides name for latest Bay of Bengal storm
stories.summary: The name Akvan was assigned to the latest cyclonic storm in the Bay of Bengal. Official naming conventions are used by meteorological agencies to provide unique identifiers for weather systems and avoid confusion during active storm seasons.

stories.title: IMD warns of heavy rain and high winds
stories.summary: The India Meteorological Department reports that Cyclone Akvan is expected to intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm by the morning of November 19. The system is forecast to bring extremely heavy rainfall and 145 kmph winds to the Andhra Pradesh coast by November 20.

stories.title: Voter leaves note and cash in ballot box
stories.summary: An Andhra Pradesh man placed two 500 rupee notes inside a ballot box along with a handwritten note stating his vote was not for sale. The incident occurred during a local voting process.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi comments on personal life at book launch
stories.summary: During the launch of Sonia Gandhi's memoir, Rahul Gandhi addressed a question regarding his personal life. When asked about his girlfriend, the Congress leader responded by describing her as a friend.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi visits parents' meeting spot in Cambridge
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi recounted taking his girlfriend to the Varsity Restaurant in Cambridge, where his parents Rajiv and Sonia first met. The visit was intended to revisit the location of his parents' early history, though the restaurant's connection to his family remains a piece of local mythology.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi shares family anecdotes at book launch
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi spoke at the launch of his mother's memoir, 'Belonging: A Journey of Love'. He recounted a visit to the restaurant where his parents met, noting that a staff member recommended the chicken chasseur, which he described as a culinary disappointment.

stories.title: Railways charges 13 people for accidental Vande Bharat trip
stories.summary: Thirteen people who boarded the Vande Bharat train at Kanpur Central to assist relatives with luggage were unable to disembark before the train departed. Railways charged the group 36,140 rupees for the 150 kilometer journey, as they lacked valid tickets for the travel.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi recalls parents' relationship
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi described his parents' emotional connection during the launch of Sonia Gandhi's memoir. He recalled family meals where his father would seat his mother on his lap, a habit he initially believed was standard behavior for all parents.
